narrative_prose: Ryn commands the galley as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea echoes outside, the sound an angry cracking hum against the hull. The starkly cold air smells of acrid ozone, while she wipes the slick condensation from the brass counter, the static tang of metal resting on her tongue, filling her sight with obsidian reflections. She must DEFEND the caloric ledger, CONCEAL the thinning emergency rations from the others, and finally hands the heavy iron ladle to Silas so he can CONSUME the hearty mire-lentil stew.
